name: NLPPlayground
description: A web app that classifies writing levels in Portuguese and performs interactive text processing tasks. Built on classical NLP and ML techniques, deployed with Streamlit.

name: Brazilian_Portuguese_Quick_APT
description: Automatic phonetic transcription for Brazilian Portuguese: developed as an undergraduate thesis using the CORAA ASR corpus and a G2P converter to build a phonetics dataset for ASR model training.

name: SarsCov2DrugHunter
description: A Streamlit app that combines molecular descriptors, bioactivity data, and ML to identify drug candidates against the SARS-CoV-2 main protease. Built for bioinformatics and ML researchers.

name: ai_job_market_dashboard
description: An LLM-powered scraper and analytics dashboard that collects AI job postings from multiple sources, normalises roles and skills, and visualises market trends interactively with Plotly and Streamlit.

name: arxhive_rag
description: A lightweight RAG-based semantic search app for ArXiv: ask a research question and get a grounded AI answer backed by the most relevant papers, powered by sentence embeddings, Chroma vector search, and a DeepSeek LLM.

name: SkillsRadar
description: An intelligent pipeline that scrapes job postings from URLs using LLMs with smart caching and deduplication, then visualises skill trends and requirements across tech roles in an interactive dashboard.
